_comment: Ratchet for the language-policy waiver store. max_waivers may only ever be lowered. A change that raises it is the change to question: it means a script was exempted rather than shortened or tested. Lower it whenever waivers are removed, so the backlog cannot silently refill.

bash-20-line-limit.goal: Drive to 0. Each entry clears by adding a bats test under tests/bats/ or by shortening the script below the limit. Tracked as ce-kx3fm.
